Removed the hard override — JS now fully controls play/pause state (still defaulting to paused for reduced-motion users).
2. Added `aria-pressed` to the SVG button, kept in sync with the actual pause state, for better accessibility signaling to screen readers.
3. Made speed changes restart the animation cleanly (via a reflow trick) so cycling speed feels immediate instead of jumping awkwardly mid-cycle.
